title: Straw Hat
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |image = Straw Hat.png |source = Egg Festival |requires = Collect at least 9 eggs |price = {{Price|1000}} }} The '''Straw Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be obtained as the reward for winning the egg hunt at the [[Egg Festival]] for the first time. After that, it can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|1000}}. It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive an outfit with the Straw Hat. ==Notes== * The male-only Straw Hat outfit also includes the [[File:Yellow Suit.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Yellow Suit]] and [[File:Farmer Pants.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Farmer Pants]] (dyed RGB value 242,189,2). * The female-only Straw Hat outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt281b.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Green Buttoned Vest]] (with sleeves dyed red) and [[File:Skirt.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Skirt]] (dyed RGB value 30,150,71). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb.
